intro.en: More school and university vocabulary: the people, the places and the techniques of studying.

la secretaría.en: the admissions office, the secretary's office

el bachillerato.en: the last two years of secondary school

texto.en:
**The system.** After **la ESO** (compulsory secondary) come two years of **bachillerato**, and then **la universidad**. Before school age there is **la guardería**.

**At university.** You **te matriculas** in **la secretaría** and pay **la matrícula**. **El catedrático** is the most senior teacher of a department. Each student has **un tutor**. The students of a class choose **un delegado**. Abroad you can do **un intercambio**, and at the end, **unas prácticas** in a company.

**Classes.** **Una clase teórica** or **práctica**. **Una conferencia** is a lecture by a guest speaker. Careful: **una lectura** is a reading, not a lecture.

**Study technique.** In class you **tomas apuntes** on **folios**. At home you **subrayas** the important points, **haces un esquema** and **un resumen**, **repasas**, and learn the difficult part **de memoria**.

**Asking.** **Tengo una duda.** **¿Puede repetirlo?** **Me he equivocado.**

**In the classroom.** **Levantar la mano.** **Salir a la pizarra.** **Trabajar en parejas** or **en grupos**. **Hacer un descanso.** The teacher **corrige** los exámenes y **pone las notas**.

**Corregir** changes: **corrijo**, **corriges**, **corrige**; **corrigió**.

frases.es: ¿Me dejas tus apuntes de Historia? Ayer no pude ir a la conferencia.
frases.en: Will you lend me your History notes? I couldn't go to the lecture yesterday.

frases.es: Claro. Lo importante está subrayado, y al final hay un esquema.
frases.en: Sure. The important stuff is underlined, and at the end there's an outline.

frases.es: Gracias. ¿Tú te lo aprendes todo de memoria?
frases.en: Thanks. Do you learn it all by heart?

frases.es: No. Hago un resumen de cada tema en un folio y lo repaso la noche anterior.
frases.en: No. I make a summary of each topic on one sheet and go over it the night before.

frases.es: Tengo una duda: ¿el examen lo corrige el catedrático o el tutor?
frases.en: I have a question: does the professor mark the exam, or the tutor?

frases.es: El catedrático. Y si te equivocas en una fecha, te baja la nota.
frases.en: The professor. And if you get a date wrong, he lowers your mark.

a conference call only.en: The usual meaning is a talk.

pregunta.en: Complete: I know the poem by heart.

corazón.en: English says by heart, but Spanish says de memoria.

corrijo.en: Before o, the g becomes j and the e becomes i.

corrigo.en: Before o, g becomes j: corrijo.

correjo.en: The vowel changes to i: corrijo.

explicacion.en: Equivocarse de: to get the wrong one.

texto.en: I was right about the classroom.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write your advice for a new student: how to take notes, revise and prepare for an exam.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Explain aloud how you study and how you learn vocabulary.
